project.name: Maverick Harness
project.description: Thin, opinionated trust boundary around coding agents — independent verification + context selection

stack.constraint: No external dependencies without user decision (INV-03)

architecture.core_thesis: The agent builds. The verifier judges. The agent never certifies its own work.
architecture.flow: HUMAN -> GENESIS (what) -> MAVERICK CONTEXT ENGINE (what now?) -> CONTEXT PACK -> CODING AGENT -> CODE -> MAVERICK VERIFY -> VERDICT

ownership.genesis: Project state and workflow: specs, tasks, decisions, invariants, gates, checkpoints
ownership.llm_wiki: Persistent knowledge: research, patterns, lessons, discoveries
ownership.codebase: Implementation truth: actual code, symbols, structure
ownership.maverick_context_engine: Context selection: minimum sufficient context for the current task
ownership.maverick_verifier: Independent judgment: binary verdict on code changes

forbidden_overlaps.maverick_must_not_become: a second Genesis, a second Wiki, a coding agent, a project manager, a generic memory system, a database, a UI
forbidden_overlaps.context_engine_must_not_become: a memory system, a vector database, an embedding store, an autonomous memory, a giant orchestration framework

authority_hierarchy.description: Information is treated according to its authority level. Derived context must never silently become authoritative.

levels.rule: Always included in context packs. Never overridden by lower levels.
Included when relevant. Can be overridden by AUTHORITATIVE.
Included when relevant. Must not contradict AUTHORITATIVE or OBSERVED without flagging.
Labeled as DERIVED. Must never silently become AUTHORITATIVE. Agent 'use Redis' = proposal until human DEC-xxx in Genesis.

context_engineering.core_question: What is the minimum sufficient context required for this agent to make a good decision on this task?
context_engineering.not: How much context can we give the agent?
context_engineering.principle: Minimum sufficient context with maximum relevance and provenance.
pack_sources: Relevant previous failures and verification evidence
context_engineering.pack_process: task -> requirements from Genesis -> decisions/invariants -> relevant Wiki knowledge -> relevant code -> relevant evidence -> rank -> compress -> CONTEXT PACK
context_engineering.pack_format: Plain structured text: TASK / AUTHORITATIVE / CURRENT STATE / RELEVANT KNOWLEDGE / RELEVANT CODE / RECENT EVIDENCE / CONSTRAINTS / SOURCE
context_engineering.token_efficiency: Prefer targeted retrieval over dumping entire files. A larger context window is not a substitute for better context selection.

invariants.rule: No coding agent certifies its own work. Only verifier VERIFIED (exit 0) counts.
Hidden QA tests are outside the agent's reach (not in agent-editable directories).
Standard library only. No external dependencies without user decision.
One function before a class. No premature abstraction.
No config without a user. Agent ideas are 'proposal'. Only the human makes a 'decision'.
No SQLite, graph, embeddings, or memory DB until a measured miss justifies it.
Any number in a doc must come from a command. Otherwise write 'unknown'.
Genesis stays unmodified. Talk to it only through its CLI. Pin its version.
Bounded repair — max 3 attempts, then BLOCKED → HUMAN.
Every context pack line shows its source ID.
Derived context must never silently become authoritative. Agent proposals are not decisions.
invariants.checked_by: context pack authority labels + proposal log (P4)

invariants.rule: Maverick does not duplicate Genesis or Wiki. It selects from them.
invariants.checked_by: code review — no competing state or knowledge stores in Maverick

invariants.rule: Context engineering answers 'what does the agent need NOW?', not 'how much can we give it?'.
invariants.checked_by: context pack size (max 8KB) and relevance eval (P3)

invariants.rule: Every abstraction must be earned by a demonstrated failure or measured need.
invariants.checked_by: miss log (P8) + decision records in Genesis

planned_structure.trap-project/run_traps.py: 8 trap scenarios — must print ALL TRAPS BEHAVE
planned_structure.context_engine/: context selection: retrieves from Genesis + Wiki + codebase, produces context packs (P3)

current_files: Maverick Harness Wiki/ (Obsidian vault — 32 pages, 221 wikilinks)

trap_scenarios.name: Mutation survives
trap_scenarios.description: Test suite too weak to detect

trust_boundaries.coding_agent: UNTRUSTED — cannot certify own work, cannot access hidden QA
trust_boundaries.hidden_qa: OUTSIDE agent reach — not in agent-editable directories
trust_boundaries.llm_wiki: KNOWLEDGE — not authoritative, must not override Genesis decisions
trust_boundaries.context_engine: SELECTOR — retrieves from sources, does not own state or knowledge
trust_boundaries.human: SOLE DECISION MAKER — agent ideas are proposals

dependencies.genesis: pinned-1.0.0 (talked to via CLI only per INV-08)
dependencies.obsidian_vault: Maverick Harness Wiki/ at project root (knowledge layer)
